rewards_limit_check.name: rewards_limit_check
rewards_limit_check.value: ("rewards"."limit_count" IS NULL AND "rewards"."limit_period" IS NULL) OR ("rewards"."limit_count" >= 1 AND "rewards"."limit_period" IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year'))

wallets_user_check.name: wallets_user_check
wallets_user_check.value: ("wallets"."kind" = 'personal' AND "wallets"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "wallets"."household_id" IS NULL) OR ("wallets"."kind" = 'shared' AND "wallets"."user_id" IS NULL AND "wallets"."household_id" IS NOT NULL)
